title: Uniform Codex account admission on the origin-less dispatch_turn route
outcome: Every Codex prompt intake route decides account admission the same way, through one helper, and the origin-less send route no longer queues a new ordinary prompt behind an existing queue while the Codex account is unusable, unless that is the intended behaviour recorded in the brief.
acceptance: The origin-less POST messages route (dispatch_turn) and the human and delegation follow-up intakes use one shared account-admission helper for local Codex sessions; the duplicated block in src/delegations.rs and src/human_prompts.rs is folded into it.

A behaviour test sends an origin-less prompt to a local Codex session with a pre-existing queue while the account is unusable and shows the decided outcome (refused, or queued and held until a successful activation), and the brief in docs/features/codex-account-login.md states that outcome.
